primary.derivation: 62041510 ps - 60877500 ps = 1164010 ps; modulo the 3000-ps clock, start is 10 ps after a negedge and end is 10 ps after a posedge.

secondary.interpretation: Inactive/internal four-state state enters or remains unknown during the window; changing only the duration gate cannot make this SAIF admissible.

only_allowed_successor.scope: fresh two-axis source-RTL VCS-only SAIF diagnostic
mandatory_changes: Retain the exact M2117 RTL, fixture, global-slot42 workload, SCHEDULE_MODE 0/1 axes, public protocol, and completion ledgers.

Move both activity stops to settled negedges: after full_execute_start is observed, wait one explicit negedge before the begin stop; after selected completion is observed, wait one explicit negedge before the end stop.

Compile with exactly one +vcs+initreg+random instrumentation option and run each axis with exactly one +vcs+initreg+0 runtime selection; disclose that this is zero-delay four-state simulation handling, not silicon initialization.
Keep the 383-cycle descriptor preload plus settled-edge public warmup/checks before activity enable.
Run no Design Compiler or PrimeTime stage in M2127.
diagnostic_admission_gates: every SAIF record has TX=0 and global TX sum is zero
all unconditional public control/counter signals and all valid-qualified payloads are known at settled negedges
ordinary and TSBG functional ledgers exactly match M2117
one compile and exactly two serial simv runs, with no retry
